title: exallage havilandii
intro: Exallage havilandii, commonly known as the Haviland's exallage, is a plant species from the family Rubiaceae. It is a shrub-like plant native to Papua New Guinea, valued for its medicinal properties. Exallage havilandii is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimalarial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, alleviating pain, and fighting off infections.
